column2: Pat sits. Pat sits in a pit.
An ant! Pat taps it.
Tap, tap, tap.
Pat naps in a pit.
A hen sits in a nest.
Hana can pet it. Pat, pat.
Hen, hen, sit in it!
Hana picks a hat. Hana sits.
Hana can nap. A hen can nap in its nest.
Hamid and Dad pack a tent.
Dad and Hamid set it in a camp.
A cat sits in it!
Scat, cat!
Hamid pets it. Hamid can pick it.
Hamid naps in a tent. Dad naps. A cat naps in it.
Huda and Mum run to a pond.
A duck is on it!
Huda got a hot crust in a sack.
Huda drops a crust.
Peck, peck! The duck gets it.
Huda and Mum grin.
Adam and Mum get on a big bus.
Mum sits. Adam sits, and the bus is off!
The bus stops at a big pond.
Adam can spot a red hen and a big pig.
A big dog can dig in the mud on a hill.
Adam and Mum get off. Adam is glad.
Jamila and Dad sit in a boat.
The boat floats on a big pond.
Rain! Drip, drop, drip.
Jamila and Dad get damp.
Dad and Jamila get off the boat and run to a big oak.
Jamila is damp, but Jamila is glad.
Bilal can see a goat on a hill.
The goat is big and soft.
Bilal fed it oats.
Rain! Drip, drop, drip.
Bilal and the goat stand at a big oak tree.
The rain stops. Bilal and the goat run on the green grass.
Hafsa sits on a swing.
Swing up, swing back!
Nan helps Hafsa swing up, up, up!
Hafsa can feel the wind.
Swing me, Nan!
Hafsa and Nan sit on the green grass and drink milk.
Idris looks up. The moon is big.
Idris sits on a soft rug in his room.
A cool wind. Rain drops on the roof.
Idris looks and looks at the moon.
Good moon, Idris will tell Mum soon.
Malak packs a lunch box: a bun, a fig and six nuts.
At lunch, Malak lifts the lid.
Yuck! A bug is on the bun!
Malak picks it up and sets it on the grass.
The bug is free!
Bismillah, said Malak, and Malak can munch the bun. Yum!
Yusuf and Dad go to the docks.
A big ship is in the port, and fish swim next to it.
Dad got a fishing rod. Yusuf got a net.
Splash! Yusuf gets a fish in his net!
That fish is thin and fast.
Then Dad and Yusuf had fish and chips for lunch.
Alhamdulillah! Yusuf thinks.
Ilham found a coin on the ground. It is big and thick.
Mum, look! A coin!
It is not our coin, said Mum.
Ilham and Mum went to the shop.
Ilham said to the man, "I found this coin."
The man thanks Ilham. Ilham is proud. It is a good deed.
It is dark. Amin is out in the yard with his dad.
A big star is up in the dark.
Look, Dad! Is that star far?
It is far, far, far, said Dad.
A cloud floats past. The star is lost!
Amin points. "Look! It is back!"
Amin is so proud.
